http/http1_chunk#

The pieces of chunked transfer coding (RFC 9112 §7.1): chunk size lines and trailer fields.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The pieces of chunked transfer coding (RFC 9112 §7.1): chunk size lines and trailer fields. Chunk extensions are checked and ignored.

Public API#

object ParsedHttp1ChunkLine#

object ParsedHttp1ChunkLine

Chunk extensions are bounded wire grammar, not application metadata. Unknown syntactically safe extensions are ignored; their values never escape here.

ParsedHttp1ChunkLine.ParsedHttp1ChunkLine#

ParsedHttp1ChunkLine(origin is string)

A chunk line without its CRLF, within the default limits.

ParsedHttp1ChunkLine.ParsedHttp1ChunkLine#

ParsedHttp1ChunkLine(origin is string, limits is Http1Limits)

The same within limits.

ParsedHttp1ChunkLine.size#

size() is int

chunk-line = 1*HEXDIG *( BWS ";" BWS token [ BWS "=" BWS ( token / quoted-string ) ] ), scanned once by character codes instead of a regex compiled for every chunk (#114).

object ParsedHttp1Trailers#

object ParsedHttp1Trailers

The trailer section after the last chunk.

ParsedHttp1Trailers.ParsedHttp1Trailers#

ParsedHttp1Trailers(origin is string, head is Headers)

The trailer text; head is the message's own fields.

ParsedHttp1Trailers.ParsedHttp1Trailers#

ParsedHttp1Trailers(origin is string, head is Headers, limits is Http1Limits)

The same within limits.

ParsedHttp1Trailers.trailers#

trailers() is Headers

The trailers; InvalidHttpMessage for fields that may not be trailers.
